video_subject: My client wants to pay me in USDT. What should I do?
video_script: A client wants to pay you in USDT, but you've never used crypto before? Don't send them the first wallet address you find. First, confirm whether they're sending USDT or USDC. Second, ask which network they're using. Third, make sure the wallet or platform receiving the money supports that exact asset and network. If this is your first stablecoin payment, I made a simple beginner guide. Link in profile.
